# James Nowlin Real Estate

> James Nowlin is a South Carolina real estate agent (license #129577) with Realty ONE Group Reside, 5300-B Sunset Blvd., Lexington, SC 29072. He helps people buy and sell homes in the Columbia, SC metro area and has a background in mortgage finance. Phone (call or text): (803) 949-0229.

## Areas served
- [Columbia](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/columbia-sc/): Columbia is South Carolina's capital and the center of the Midlands, sitting where the Broad and Saluda rivers meet to form the Congaree. Its housing runs from early-1900s bungalows in historic neighborhoods to downtown condos and newer subdivisions on the northeast side, which gives buyers more range of age, style and price than anywhere else in the region.
- [Lexington](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/lexington-sc/): Lexington is the county seat of Lexington County, about 13 miles west of downtown Columbia and just south of Lake Murray. It's one of the faster-growing parts of the Midlands, with a mix of newer subdivisions, established neighborhoods and a walkable town center. James's office is on Sunset Boulevard in Lexington.
- [Irmo](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/irmo-sc/): Irmo sits northwest of Columbia between the Saluda River and the east end of Lake Murray, and straddles Lexington and Richland counties. Together with Ballentine and the wider Dutch Fork area, it offers established neighborhoods, easy I-26 access and short trips to both the lake and the city.
- [Chapin](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/chapin-sc/): Chapin is a small town on the north side of Lake Murray that calls itself the Capital of Lake Murray. It offers a compact town center, newer neighborhoods, lake-access and waterfront homes, and land toward the countryside, about 25 miles northwest of Columbia off I-26.
- [Lake Murray](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/lake-murray-sc/): Lake Murray is a reservoir of about 50,000 acres west of Columbia, created when the Saluda Dam was finished in 1930. It has about 650 miles of shoreline across four counties, and its homes range from full-time waterfront houses with private docks to off-water homes in lake-access neighborhoods.
- [West Columbia & Cayce](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/west-columbia-cayce-sc/): West Columbia and Cayce sit right across the Congaree River from downtown Columbia in Lexington County. They offer some of the shortest commutes into the city, older homes with character, the Riverwalk along the water, and easy access to the airport and Lexington Medical Center.
- [Blythewood](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/blythewood-sc/): Blythewood is a growing town north of Columbia along I-77, mostly in Richland County with parts in Fairfield County. It offers newer subdivisions, homes on larger lots, and quick interstate access to Columbia and Charlotte.
- [Forest Acres](https://jimmyardis.github.io/james-nowlin1/areas/forest-acres-sc/): Forest Acres is a small, independent city surrounded by Columbia, a few miles east of downtown. It's known for mid-century homes on large, wooded lots, the Forest Lake area, and convenient shopping at Trenholm Plaza, all within a short drive of the city center.

## Key facts
- South Carolina requires a licensed attorney to conduct real estate closings.
- Primary residences are assessed at 4% for property tax (6% otherwise); owners must apply with the county assessor.
- Most SC sellers must complete the Residential Property Condition Disclosure Statement.
- Home search: https://jamesnowlin.myrealtyonegroup.com/property-search-map/sale/status-active;pending/type-single%20family;condo!townhouse;land;Multi_Family;farm;mobile!manufactured/dsort-n
- Home value estimate: https://jamesnowlin.myrealtyonegroup.com/my-home-value
